US Senator Criticizes Pakistan's Mediator Role Amid Iran Conflict

US Senator Rick Scott expressed concern over Pakistan's role as a mediator in the Iran conflict, stating, 'Remember who Pakistan really is.' He specifically referenced Pakistan's past as the nation where Osama bin Laden hid. Scott's remarks followed Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif's tribute to Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei, highlighting what Scott called Pakistan's 'double role.'
